Support the pattern where an unbounded scalar is spilled to the stack
then boundary checks are performed on the src register
stack frame slot is refilled into a register.
Before this commit
column2: the verifier didn't treat the src register and the

column1: stack slot as related if the src register was an unbounded scalar. The
register state wasn't copied
slot was marked as STACK_MISC. Subsequent boundary checks on the src
register wouldn't result in updating the boundaries of the spilled
variable on the stack.
After this commit
column2: the verifier will preserve the bond between src and

column1: dst even if src is unbounded
column2: which permits to do boundary checks on src

column1: and refill dst later
column2: still remembering its boundaries. Such a pattern

column1: is sometimes generated by clang when compiling complex long functions.
One test is adjusted to reflect that now unbounded scalars are tracked.
